title: Serial overhead around seeding and setup
body:
On a 481.8 s search of all Pfam against one MGnify recall shard of 2,455,940 targets at 48 threads, the `-s` runtime tree shows 30 s of serial work, 6.2% of the run. Two items make up 72% of it, and both have known fixes:

| item | seconds | issue |
|---|---|---|
| mmseqs target db write | 15.5 | nail-fc2ac4 |
| profile parse in `build_pipeline` | 6.2 | nail-65ce8f |

The rest of the serial work sums to 1.7% of the run. The tree and the breakdown are in the notes. nail-7ea5c0 decided that moving nail's io onto `libsail` is separate work, now nail-167dd7, and neither fix waits on it.

## Out of scope

- Caching the target db across runs. It helps only repeated runs, and those do not matter here.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text:
Serial seconds and share of the 481.8 s run: db write 15.5 (3.2%), pipeline build 6.2 (1.3%), slice+decide+merge 3.4 (0.7%), query+target index 2.7 (0.6%), seed index 1.6 (0.3%), convertalis 0.7 (0.1%). All serial: 30.1 s, 6.2%. Removing every one entirely buys 6%.

Below the two big items, the mechanisms (2026-09-28 code survey):
- PrefilterDb re-opens the file on every get and next_n (mmseqs.rs:177), validates every record with an open+seek+1-byte read in from_path (153-161), scans bytes for newlines by hand, and does all of it on one thread between align calls. Slice writes a record for Terminated queries too (TODO at seed_stage.rs:187). A held handle or mmap, memchr, and rayon over queries fixes slice, decide and merge together; worth about 3 s.
- Seeds::from_path allocates a String and a Vec per TSV line, serial.
- Index passes: single-threaded, CHUNKS=1 in from_path; the HMM index does a strum match per line; the HMM file is then read a second time to parse profiles. A single pass that indexes and parses would remove the second read.
- Convertalis and the merge could go entirely if nail read the per-iteration align dbs into Seeds directly; gain about 1 s, cost is parsing mmseqs's alignment record. Not worth it on these numbers.

Parallel side, for proportion: prefilter is 225 s (47%), all mmseqs, untouched by anything serial. Alignment at 93% busy idles about 12 s.
